name: How does general contractor trade coordination compare to managing plumbers myself?

mainEntity.name: How does general contractor trade coordination compare to managing plumbers myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coordinating plumbing through a single general contractor prevents schedule gaps, rework, and accountability finger-pointing. When homeowners hire a separate plumber and a separate tile or drywall installer, delays by one trade stall the other, and neither takes responsibility if a pipe cutout misaligns with tile backer board. Working with Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling LLC gives you a single point of contact. We align the plumber's rough-in measurements directly with our custom framing and tile plans, ensuring pipe penetrations, shower pans, and drain slopes fit the finished design on the first attempt.
acceptedAnswer.description: GC coordination eliminates scheduling friction and finger-pointing, ensuring plumbing lines align precisely with your framing, drywall, and custom tile installations.
